t.name: Tombstone Lake Trail #55
t.description: Tombstone lake trail #55 in the Indian Heaven Wilderness leaves from the Pacific Crest National Scenic Trail #2000 near the east shore of Blue Lake and ends 0.5 mile away at Tombstone Lake.

t.name: Thomas Lake Trail #111
t.description: This 3.3 mile heavily used trail passes numerous lakes prior to its connection with the Pacific Crest National Scenic Trail #2000 within Indian Heaven Wilderness.

t.name: East Crater Trail #48
t.description: This moderately used trail is one of the main access routes from the east into the central part of Indian Heaven Wilderness. Trail features include small lakes, ponds, marshes, meadows, wildflowers, and Junction Lake.

t.name: Shortcut Trail #171A
t.description: Trail #171A is a 0.5 shortcut trail that connects Race Track Trail #171 to Pacific Crest National Scenic Trail #2000 within Indian Heaven Wilderness.

t.name: Indian Race Track Trail #171
t.description: The trail travels through second growth forest, rocky terrain , a meadow and ends near Red Mountain fire lookout. The meadow was the site of annual gatherings of Native Americans during huckleberry season.

t.name: Valley Ski Trail #151
t.description: The trail passes through the forest, descends into the Wind River Valley, and crosses a bridge over the Wind River. After the bridge it climbs up to a clearcut and intersects with Forest Road 3053.

t.name: Terminator Trail #159
t.description: This 4.2 mile trail is mainly a winter cross-country ski trail, and makes a loop when combined with McClellan Trail #157.

t.name: McClellan Meadows Trail #157
t.description: The trail follows the route of George McClellan's 1852 railroad survey. A popular but challenging mountain biking trail with a grades and stream crossings.

t.name: Falls Creek Trail #152
t.description: The gradual grade of this 9 mile trail slowly climbs away from Falls Creek and crosses 2 creeks before reaching the waterfall in approximately 2.5 miles.

t.name: Falls Creek Falls Trail #152A
t.description: This trail provides spectacular views of the white water of Falls Creek. The mist from the cascades of Falls Creek creates an excellent area to rest among a blanket of mosses.

t.name: Observation Trail #132
t.description: This trail provides access to Trapper Creek Wilderness. Beautiful wildflowers and Bear Grass are abundant along the trail in season. The trail provides majestic views of Mt. Adams, Mt. Rainier, and Mount St. Helens.

t.name: Big Hollow Trail #158
t.description: The 3.2 mile Big Hollow Trail begins on Forest Road 64 at Big Hollow Trailhead and climbs steadily to its terminus on Observation Trail #132 at the Trapper Creek Wilderness boundary.

t.name: Dry Creek Trail #194
t.description: This 4 mile trail runs north and south to the east of Trapper Creek Wilderness. This trail offers the opportunity to hike through an old-growth forest. Views of sparkling Dry Creek and the turbulent Bourbon Creek enhance this trail.

t.name: Trapper Creek Trail #192
t.description: The trail follows Trapper Creek through the Trapper Creek Wilderness climbing steeply up to a junction with the Big Hollow Trail near Sister Rocks.
